# vergeio_cloudinitfiles (Data Source)

Retrieves information about cloud-init files stored in VergeOS. Cloud-init files are used to configure VMs during first boot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get all cloud-init files
data "vergeio_cloudinitfiles" "all" {
}

output "cloudinit_files" {
  value = data.vergeio_cloudinitfiles.all.cloudinit_files
}
```

Filter by name:
```terraform
data "vergeio_cloudinitfiles" "userdata" {
  filter_name = "user-data"
}

output "userdata_files" {
  value = data.vergeio_cloudinitfiles.userdata.cloudinit_files
}
```

## Example Output

```
cloudinit_files = [
  {
    id                 = "1"
    name               = "user-data"
    filesize           = 512
    contents           = "#cloud-config\nusers:\n  - name: ubuntu\n"
    contains_variables = false
  }
]
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String) - Filter cloud-init files by name

### Read-Only

- `cloudinit_files` (List of Object) - List of cloud-init files (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloudinit_files))

<a id="nestedatt--cloudinit_files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloudinit_files`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) - Cloud-init file ID
- `name` (String) - File name (e.g., `user-data`, `meta-data`, `vendor-data`, `network-data`)
- `filesize` (Number) - File size in bytes
- `contents` (String) - File contents
- `contains_variables` (Boolean) - Whether the file contains template variables
